title: Make task attachment creation collision-safe
description: Deep-dive audit 2026-08-08 verified a check-then-create race in TaskDomainService: GetUniqueFileName checks File.Exists, then SaveAsync calls File.Create. Concurrent uploads can select the same candidate and collide or overwrite. Evidence: MemorySmith.App/Services/TaskDomainService.cs lines 74-116. Use exclusive create semantics with retry and add concurrent upload coverage.
